Name: Craftable Balloons
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[youtube]7nRdaszt3JQ[/youtube]

This mod adds a balloon item to the game that you can craft using 5 slime, 1 solar essence, and one void essence.

Balloon color is taken randomly from the game's built-in rainbow colors. By default there is a 5% chance for a balloon to be prismatic.

When a balloon is the current active item, it will be shown with the player sprite.

To set a balloon to always be shown, place it on the farmer's picture in the inventory page.

To apply a balloon to an NPC, pet, monster or farm animal, hold down the mod key (default: left shift) and left click on the character.


[b][size=5]Custom Balloons[/size]
[/b]
You can change the balloon sprite by targetting "aedenthorn.CraftableBalloons/balloon" using Content Patcher.

You can create custom balloon objects, by telling the mod their texture paths with Content Patcher targetting the mod's dictionary, e.g.:

[code]{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "aedenthorn.CraftableBalloons/dict",
"Entries": {
"MyMod_PurpleShortsBalloon": "MyMod/PurpleShorts"
}
}[/code]
The key is the ItemId, and the value is the texture path for Content Patcher. The texture it leads to must be laid out in the same way as this mod's assets/Balloon.png file.


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
